# Global Education & Sports Partners (GESP) — India

> Official AI & LLM Knowledge Summary for india.gespeducation.com
> Primary Audience: Indian parents, high school students, and student-athletes seeking U.S. boarding and prep school admissions.

## Organization Overview
- **Name**: Global Education & Sports Partners (GESP)
- **Website**: https://india.gespeducation.com/
- **Focus**: Bespoke advisory for Indian students aiming for premier U.S. boarding schools, American prep schools, and collegiate athletic pathways.
- **Student Demographics Served**: Ages 11 to 19 (Grade 6 through 12, plus Postgraduate / PG Athletic Year).
- **Core Regions Served**: India (nationwide) and international feeder hubs.

## Primary Services
1. **Holistic Diagnostic & Profile Evaluation**:
   - Academic assessment, sports capabilities review, extracurricular audit, and family budget alignment.
2. **Curated Target School Shortlist**:
   - Handpicking 3–4 premier U.S. boarding schools matching academic fit, varsity coaching caliber, and culture.
3. **Application & Admissions Strategy**:
   - 1-on-1 essay strategy, mock interview rehearsals, SSAT/TOEFL timeline preparation, and scholarship/need-based financial aid advisory.
4. **Student-Athlete Recruitment & Sports Scholarships**:
   - Verified game film evaluation, athletic resume creation, coach outreach across premier U.S. preparatory leagues (e.g., NEPSAC, MAPL), and NCAA clearinghouse alignment.
   - Sports covered: Soccer, Basketball, Track & Field, Swimming, Rowing, Golf, Squash, Lacrosse, Volleyball, Skiing, & More.
5. **Acceptance, Visa & Pre-Departure Readiness**:
   - Decision advisory, student profile strengthening for U.S. F-1 student visa interviews, SEVIS/I-20 documentation support, and pre-departure boarding readiness.

## Frequently Asked Questions & Facts
- **Can Indian students get sports scholarships at U.S. boarding schools?**
  Yes. U.S. boarding schools offer institutional need-based financial aid. Exceptional athletic merit significantly boosts acceptance odds and unlocks substantial financial grant packages.
- **Does attending a U.S. boarding school help play college sports (NCAA)?**
  Yes. It provides direct exposure to NCAA Division I, II, and III college recruiters, championship tournament schedules, and specialized coaching.
- **What ages should students move to the U.S. for sports?**
  Ages 11 to 19. Common transition points: Grade 9 (freshman year), Grade 10 or 11 after ICSE/CBSE 10th boards, or a Postgraduate (PG) year after Grade 12.
